headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas set your daily trade cap from your own results, add a short gap after every trade (wins too), and flag coins whose futures price runs far above spot.

ideas.title: Daily trade cap from your own history
ideas.why: /week groups your past days by how many trades you took (1–2, 3–4, 5–6, 7+) and shows win rate and P&L for each. The cap in tilt.py becomes the count where your days turn red, instead of a fixed 8. Your own numbers, not a rule from a book.

ideas.title: 5-minute gap after every trade, not just losses
ideas.why: tilt.py only flags entries within 15 min of a loss. Overtrading also starts after wins: the click itself feels good. Flag any entry within 5 min of the last exit, count them in /tilt, and show the gap rule in the morning brief.

ideas.title: "Premium" flag: futures price far above or below spot
ideas.why: The scanner already pulls /fapi/v1/premiumIndex but only uses funding. Its markPrice vs indexPrice gives the live perp-vs-spot gap. A big gap on a mover means the move is mostly leveraged futures traders, which tends to unwind. Show it next to Crowded.
